task.ques: Identify the latest top-trending open-source project in the topic of 'Machine Learning' on GitHub, and check the number of stars it has received.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: tensorflow/tensorflow has 201,273 stars (displayed as 201k), verified October 28, 2026. It is the first project on GitHub’s Machine learning topic page with Language: All and Sort: Most stars.
Evidence: https://github.com/topics/machine-learning — “An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone,” with the machine-learning topic. The star counter’s title is “201,273” and its accessible label is “201273 users starred this repository.” Repository: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow. Screenshot: final.png.
The topic page ranks projects by cumulative stars and offers no Trending sort. This is the most-starred Machine Learning topic project, rather than a latest Trending winner.
